title: শিরোনাম
name: নাম বা ডাকনাম
backupSaved: ব্যাকআপ আপলোড এবং যাচাই করা হয়েছে
alreadyImported: এই ব্যাকআপটি ইতিমধ্যেই আমদানি করা হয়েছে
error: অপারেশন ব্যর্থ হয়েছে। আপনার তথ্য মুছে ফেলা হয়নি.
saveError: সংরক্ষিত হয়নি। এই পৃষ্ঠাটি খোলা রাখুন এবং আবার সংরক্ষণ করার চেষ্টা করুন।
trashConfirm: ট্র্যাশে সরান? আপনি পরে এটি পুনরুদ্ধার করতে পারেন।
permanentConfirm: স্থায়ীভাবে মুছে ফেলবেন? নির্বাচিত সামগ্রী ট্র্যাশ থেকে পুনরুদ্ধার করা যাবে না৷
restoreConfirm: এই সংস্করণটি পুনরুদ্ধার করবেন? বর্তমান সংস্করণ ইতিহাসে থাকে।
discardChanges: এই পরিবর্তনগুলি সংরক্ষণ না করেই চলে যাবেন?
noNotifications: এই সময়সীমা একটি বিজ্ঞপ্তি পাঠায় না।
freeOffline: বিনামূল্যে নোট এবং করণীয়. অফলাইনে কাজ করে।
backupExplanation: আপনার Google ড্রাইভে এনক্রিপ্ট করা ব্যাকআপ। স্থানীয় ফাইল একটি অ্যাকাউন্ট ছাড়া কাজ.
backupManual: আপনি বোতাম টিপলে ব্যাকআপ শুরু হয়। পূর্ববর্তী ড্রাইভ কপি রাখা হয়.
privacySummary: নোটগুলি আপনার ডিভাইসে থাকে। আপনি যখন তাদের অনুরোধ করেন শুধুমাত্র এনক্রিপ্ট করা ব্যাকআপ আপলোড করা হয়।
passwordWarning: কমপক্ষে 12টি অক্ষর ব্যবহার করুন। এই পাসওয়ার্ড নিরাপদ রাখুন: এটি ছাড়া, একটি নতুন ফোন ব্যাকআপ খুলতে পারে না।
passwordPrompt: এই ব্যাকআপ তৈরি করার সময় ব্যবহৃত পাসওয়ার্ড লিখুন।
passwordRule: কমপক্ষে 12টি অক্ষরের একটি পাসওয়ার্ড ব্যবহার করুন।
backupError: ব্যাকআপ ব্যর্থ হয়েছে। আপনার পাসওয়ার্ড, ফাইল, ইন্টারনেট সংযোগ এবং ড্রাইভ অ্যাক্সেস পরীক্ষা করুন, তারপর আবার চেষ্টা করুন।
googleSetup: এই বিল্ডের জন্য Google সংযোগ কনফিগার করা হয়নি। GOOGLE_SETUP.md দেখুন।
accountMismatch: এই ব্যাকআপটি একটি ভিন্ন Google অ্যাকাউন্টের অন্তর্গত।
accountSwitchConfirm: এই ফোনে স্থানীয় ডেটার জন্য এই Google অ্যাকাউন্টটি ব্যবহার করবেন? ভবিষ্যতে ব্যাকআপ এই অ্যাকাউন্টে যাবে।
disconnectConfirm: Google সংযোগ বিচ্ছিন্ন করবেন? স্থানীয় নোট এবং বিদ্যমান ড্রাইভ ব্যাকআপ থাকবে।
restoreMerge: আলাদা ফোল্ডারে আমদানি করবেন? বিদ্যমান ডেটা অপরিবর্তিত থাকে। একই আমদানির পুনরাবৃত্তি কোনো সদৃশ যোগ করে না।
lockUnavailable: প্রথমে আপনার ফোন সেটিংসে একটি স্ক্রিন লক সেট আপ করুন৷
xPurchaseInfo: Your purchase can be restored with the same Google Play account. No subscription.
xMoneyJournalInfo: Personal records and reports only. No bank connection, card payments or money transfers.
xExternal: Open this link in another app? That service may receive your request.
xPlainExport: Export an unencrypted copy outside Bilga? Anyone with access to that file can read it.
xModelInfo: Local AI. Download the model first, then test this device before purchasing. Answers may be wrong. Text stays on this device.
xUnsupported: This device does not currently meet the requirements. More RAM and storage are required.
xMediaLocalBackup: Attachments require a complete local .bilga2 backup. Export it from Settings; Drive backup is not used for these files.
xChatInfo: The conversation is cleared when you leave this page. Actions require your confirmation.
hEncourage: A missed day does not erase what you have learned. Start again with a small step. Paused days do not earn a completion.
turboDeferred: Optional local AI is not included in this lightweight build. It is not offered for purchase here.
gNetwork: No connection or the request timed out. Your local data is still available. Try again when connected.
gCanceled: Sign-in was not completed. Try again. If this repeats, check the app signing SHA and Web client ID.
gAuth: Google authorization failed or expired. Connect your Google account again.
gPermission: Drive refused access. Grant Drive permission; the developer must also enable Drive API and verify OAuth setup.
gUnavailable: Google Drive is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
tagDuplicate: এই নামের একটি ট্যাগ ইতিমধ্যে আছে।
tagDeleteConfirm: লাইব্রেরি ও সব নোট থেকে এই ট্যাগ মুছবেন? নোটগুলো রাখা হবে।
widgetApprove: আমি নিশ্চিত করছি এই নোটে ব্যক্তিগত তথ্য নেই
widgetPrivacyInfo: লঞ্চার লেখা রেখে লক স্ক্রিনেও দেখাতে পারে। কেবল অসংবেদনশীল নোট বাছুন। বদলানো লেখা আবার অনুমোদন করুন। Android লঞ্চারের আগে সংরক্ষণ করা কপি মুছে ফেলার নিশ্চয়তা দেওয়া যায় না।
widgetPermissionHint: নোট কার্ডে “উইজেটে দেখানোর অনুমতি দিন” চালু করুন। ডিফল্টভাবে বন্ধ থাকে।
reminderMessage: আপনার একটি কাজ সম্পন্ন করতে হবে।
reminderOverlayInfo: ঐচ্ছিক: Android সেটিংসে অন্য অ্যাপের উপরে অনুস্মারক দেখানোর অনুমতি দিন। এই অনুমতি ছাড়াও বিজ্ঞপ্তি কাজ করে।
reminderPrivacy: শিরোনাম অন্যরা দেখতে পারেন এবং লঞ্চার লক স্ক্রিনেও সংরক্ষণ করতে পারে। শুধু অসংবেদনশীল লেখার অনুমতি দিন। পুরোনো কপি মুছে ফেলার নিশ্চয়তা নেই।
reminderLimits: Android অনুস্মারক দেরি করতে বা প্যানেল লুকাতে পারে। বিজ্ঞপ্তি, নির্ভুল অ্যালার্ম ও ব্যাটারি সেটিংস দেখুন; পপ-আপ নিশ্চিত নয়।
widgetNotesUnavailable: নোট এখনও প্রস্তুত নয়। Bilga বা ডিভাইস আনলক করে আবার চেষ্টা করুন। উইজেটের অনুমতিগুলি সংরক্ষিত থাকবে।
readOnlyInfo: Reading and exporting remain available. A lifetime purchase is required to create or edit after the trial.
searchAssistantInfo: Offline text search shows excerpts from your own records with links to their sources. It does not generate answers or change your data.
lifetimeInfo: One payment. Lifetime access. No subscription, ads, or automatic charge.
plannerReminderInfo: A task due date and a notification reminder are separate. Configure reminders in the task editor.
trialIntroduction: Use Bilga free for 40 days. Then unlock lifetime access with one payment. No subscription or automatic charge.
trialUnavailable: Trial status could not be read. Retry; your data is preserved.
trialClock: The device date moved backwards. Enable automatic date and time, then retry.
debugTrialInfo: DEBUG · Trial scenario only · No paid entitlement
purchaseNotConfigured: Google Play purchase is not configured in this build. Trial, reading and exports remain available.
purchasePending: Payment is pending. Access unlocks after Google Play confirms completion.
purchaseRevoked: The purchase was revoked. Your data is preserved.
purchaseVerification: Purchase could not be verified. Try Restore purchases later. Your active trial continues.
purchaseAcknowledgement: Access is saved; Google Play acknowledgement will be retried. Use Restore purchases when online.
purchaseUnavailable: Google Play is temporarily unavailable. Your active trial and verified access are preserved.
richInvalidLink: Enter a valid https, http or email link.
richUnsupported: This formatting cannot be edited in this version. Your original text and formatting are preserved; you can read or export the note.
repeatInvalidInterval: Choose a whole interval from 1 to 365.
repeatInvalidEnd: End date must be on or after the first occurrence.
repeatDueRequired: Choose a due date before repeating this task.
repeatFuture: Apply changes to this and future occurrences
repeatOnly: Other edits affect only this occurrence.
repeatHistorical: This is a past occurrence. Manage the schedule from the current task.
repeatExplain: The original schedule is kept. Completing an overdue occurrence skips missed dates.
repeatReopen: Reopen the completed task to change its schedule.
repeatClearDue: Turn off repeat before removing the due date.
taskTemplateEmpty: Save a task as a template or create one here.
taskTemplateDeleteInfo: Delete this template? Tasks already created from it stay unchanged.
taskTemplateIndependent: Each use creates an independent task with unchecked subtasks. Dates, reminders and widget consent are not copied.
taskProjectStatusInfo: Project status is separate from task completion. Task deadlines and reminders stay unchanged.
taskProjectRemoveInfo: Remove project details? Nested lists and tasks stay unchanged.
fAccountArchiveInfo: Balances and history are preserved. Archived accounts remain in totals.
fAccountLocalInfo: These are local records. Transfers use this ledger’s currency and do not move bank money or convert currencies.
fAccountReconcileInfo: Reconciliation adds a dated adjustment to match an observed balance. It is excluded from income and expense reports.
fAccountNeedActive: Create or restore an active account first.
fAccountMatched: Balance already matched; no monetary adjustment.
fTransactionCurrent: The current transaction is shown above. History keeps the state before each change.
fTransactionRestoreInfo: Restore this saved transaction? Other transactions remain as they are. The current state will also be kept in history.
fDebtHasRepayments: This debt has repayments. Undo those repayments before undoing the debt.
fTransactionUndoInfo: Update this transaction’s effect on balances? Its saved states remain in history.
fReportInfo: Transfers cancel out. Loans, repayments and balance adjustments do not count as income or expenses. Opening balances are shown separately.
fReportRangeError: Choose a shorter period (up to 3,660 days).
bTitleInvalid: Enter a title of up to 200 characters.
bIsbnInvalid: Enter a valid ISBN-10 or ISBN-13, or leave it empty.
bPageInvalid: The current page cannot exceed the total pages.
bLabelsInvalid: Use up to 50 labels, each up to 100 characters.
bDatesInvalid: Use valid dates; the finish must not precede the start.
bLabelsInfo: Separate names with commas or new lines.
gMissing: You can scroll to the control or exit the guide and continue normally.
hgAbout: Build a routine you can keep. Choose your days, track a small action or a quantity, and see your progress over time.
hgHow: Choose a template or create your own habit. For a yes/no habit, keep the target at 1. For reading or walking, choose a quantity and unit. Check in today or correct an earlier day using its calendar chip. A scheduled missed day breaks the streak; a deliberate pause does not earn a completion.
hgSafe: The guide works offline. It uses the real editor and never saves for you. Only Save creates a habit. Skip or Exit closes the guidance without discarding your draft.
hgRestart: An unfinished guide is available. After an app restart, we start with the name again because unsaved form drafts are not stored.
hgTitle: Enter a name for your habit in the highlighted field. When finished, tap Next. Nothing is saved yet.
hgSchedule: Choose the weekdays when you want to practice. Selected days are highlighted. Keep every day selected for a daily habit, then tap Next.
hgTarget: Keep 1 for a yes/no habit, or enter your daily quantity, such as 10 for reading. Then tap Next.
hgSave: Review your choices. Tap the highlighted Save button when ready. The guide advances only after the habit is saved successfully; errors keep your draft.
hgProgress: Your habit is saved. Today shows completed habits out of those scheduled for today. Use Check in for a quantity; calendar days let you correct history. Mark a day only after you actually practice.
htPreviewNotice: These are editable suggestions. Previewing or choosing one creates no habit. Customize the form and tap Save when you are ready.
htWhy_water: Keep a simple record of the amount you choose to drink.
htWhy_walk: Make room for a short walk that fits your day.
htWhy_exercise: Choose a realistic movement routine on selected days.
htWhy_sleep: Choose a bedtime and reflect on keeping it.
htWhy_stretch: Add a short movement break to your routine.
htWhy_read: Protect a little time for reading each day.
htWhy_math: Practice a few problems and track your study time.
htWhy_language: Practice vocabulary, listening or speaking consistently.
htWhy_lessons: Return to what you learned before it fades.
htWhy_study: Reserve a focused study block on weekdays.
htWhy_plan: Choose a few priorities before the next day begins.
htWhy_important: Make progress on one thing that matters to you.
htWhy_distractions: Try one focused period with distractions put aside.
htWhy_desk: Leave your workspace ready for your next session.
htWhy_tidy: Spend a few minutes on one small area.
htWhy_journal: Write a few lines about your day in your own words.
htWhy_reflect: Pause to notice what worked and what to change.
htWhy_skill: Make a little time for deliberate practice.
htWhy_expenses: Review your actual spending and record it yourself.
htWhy_budget: Set aside a weekly moment to check your own plan.
htWhy_quiet: Choose a short quiet or reflective practice that suits you.
htWhy_rest: Step away briefly and return with intention.
hgUnit: For a quantity habit, enter a unit such as pages or minutes. You can leave this blank for a yes/no habit. Then tap Next.
rDuplicateExplain: This is the same file. Open the existing book or deliberately add another copy.
rEmptyLibrary: Your library is ready. Import a PDF, EPUB or TXT file, or try the original Bilga sample.
rErrorChanged: The chosen file differs from the original. Choose the same file to preserve your reading locations.
rErrorCorrupt: This document could not be read safely. It may be damaged or contain unsupported content.
rErrorEmpty: This file contains no readable content.
rErrorEncoding: Save this text as UTF-8 or UTF-16 with a byte-order mark, then import it again.
rErrorLarge: This file exceeds safe limits: PDF 1 GB; EPUB 256 MB compressed and expanded; text or individual EPUB entry 16 MB.
rErrorProtected: Password-protected or DRM-protected books are not supported. Choose an unprotected copy you are authorized to read.
rErrorUnavailable: The file is unavailable. Check its location and access permission. You can relink the original file.
rErrorUnsupported: Use PDF, EPUB or TXT. HTML and FB2 support text only; DOCX and RTF are not supported.
rGuideChoose: Choose a supported file in Android’s picker. Cancel safely to return; no book is created until validation succeeds.
rGuideImport: Tap Import a book. Android’s file picker will open.
rGuideRead: Your book was imported. Tap Read on its card to open the actual reader.
rHelpText: Import a local PDF, EPUB or TXT to start reading. A private encrypted copy is the default. Advanced organization includes external references and optional book details. PDF text selection works when embedded text and copy permissions are available; scanned pages can have page notes. EPUB is reflowed with local images; publisher CSS, audio, video and scripts are not rendered. HTML and FB2 are text-only. Save bookmarks, highlights and cards separately from the original file. Full encrypted backups include managed files; metadata backups require you to relink originals. Reading settings and help work offline.
rLibraryPurpose: Your books, ready to read. Import a file and continue where you stopped.
rNoActivity: Reading activity will appear here after you spend time reading.
rNoMatches: No matching text. Scanned PDFs may contain images only; OCR is not included.
rNoReadingNotes: Save a bookmark or select a passage in the reader. Cards and reviews are optional.
rNotesPurpose: Your bookmarks, highlights, notes and study cards stay linked to this book. Export shares reading data; use encrypted backup for complete recovery.
rPagedHint: Pinch to zoom and pan this page. Switch off page-by-page mode to search, select and highlight PDF text.
rReviewFinished: No more due cards in this batch. Return later for your next review.
rSamplePreview: Add the original Bilga reading sample to your library? It is a short, freely reusable demonstration text, not a purchased book.
rSaveRetry: Reading data could not be saved. Keep this screen open and retry.
rScheduleExplanation: Leitner review: Again resets to 1 day; Hard keeps your box; Good advances one box; Easy advances two. Intervals are 1, 2, 4, 7, 14, 30 and 60 calendar days. Overdue cards remain due. A rating saves an immutable history entry. Up to 100 due cards are shown per batch.
rSessionExplanation: Time is an estimate of foreground reading. It pauses in the background, on other screens, when paused, or after two minutes without interaction. Reading the last page does not finish a book automatically.
rStorageChoice: Default import saves a private encrypted copy. Referencing a device file saves space, but access depends on that file and its provider. Relink the same original if access is lost.
rSampleBody:
Bilga reading sample

This original demonstration text may be freely used and redistributed.

Read a little each day. A useful idea becomes clearer when you explain it in your own words.

Select this passage, save a highlight and create a question card: What helps me remember an idea?

An answer might be: explain it, connect it with experience and review it later.

You can bookmark this paragraph, close the book and continue reading later.
rTemplatePreview: Preview only. Continue to edit; a record is created only when you save.
rGuideNavigate: Use the page or chapter controls to move through the book. The current location saves automatically. Then tap Next.
rGuideAppearance: Open reading settings and adjust typography or theme, then close the settings panel.
rGuideBookmark: Tap the bookmark button. Add an optional label and save. Cancelling does not complete this step.
rGuideHighlight: Long-press readable text and select Highlight in its context menu, choose a color and save. Scanned PDFs allow page notes instead.
rGuideCard: Open the menu and choose Create a card. Pick a type, enter your own content and save; nothing is created on cancel.
rGuideSaved: Saved. Open Bookmarks and cards from the menu to return to the source or review question cards.
rGuideFlip: Tap Show answer to flip the real question card.
rGuideRate: Choose Again, Hard, Good or Easy. Your rating updates the due date and adds one history entry.
rGuideOrganize: Open Organize and advanced options. Choose a shelf filter, or open a book’s details to edit its shelves and tags. Existing reading stays intact.
rContinueHelp: Use Continue reading on a book card. Imported books restore their saved page or paragraph even after closing the reader.
rBackupChoice: Choose what to include. Full encrypted backup streams managed files with reading data. Metadata and reading data only keeps bookmarks, cards, history and file identities, but you must relink original files after restoring. External references always require their originals. Keep enough free space for the encrypted output.
rBackupSize: of managed files, plus encrypted reading data and a small encryption overhead.
rPartialFormat: This format opens as simplified text only. Images, layout, interactive content and publisher styles are not preserved. Continue?
rPdfSettingsHint: PDF keeps its original layout. Pinch to zoom. Themes change reader controls; text size and spacing settings apply to EPUB and TXT.
rGuideAppearanceDone: Reading settings are applied. In read-only mode, changes last only for this session.
rGuideNavigationDone: You moved to a new reading location. Continue reading, or open Bookmarks and cards from the menu.
ePurpose: Learn from your days. Capture what happened, what you learned and one useful next step.
eHelp: Choose New experience, give it a title and reflect in your own words. Save only when ready. Use an experiment for a hypothesis and evidence. Templates are optional drafts; calendar and summaries use only your saved entries.
eTagsHint: Separate tags with commas. Up to 30 tags.
eTemplateSafe: Preview first. A template opens an editable draft; nothing is added until you tap Save.
eEmpty: Start with a small moment or a useful lesson. You can also choose a template. No entries match the current filters.
eSummaryHint: Counts reflect saved entries and your chosen completion status. They do not judge the quality of your learning.
eHistoryHint: Every saved change is retained. Restoring a version creates a new change and keeps later history. Earlier edits made before history support are unavailable.
eLink: Link a note, book or habit
eLinkMissing: This linked record is no longer available. The experience is preserved.
ePendingLink: Task creation was interrupted. Tap Follow-up task to safely resume.
eNoLinkTargets: No matching saved records. Create a note, book or habit first.
egCreate: Tap New experience to open a real draft. No record is created yet.
egBody: Enter a title, then describe something you experienced. Write a few words here and choose Next.
egSave: Save your real entry. If saving fails, the draft stays open and the guide waits.
egResults: Your entry is saved. History keeps changes; Follow-up task turns an idea into an action. Calendar and summaries show real results.
ePrompt_body: Describe the situation in your own words.
ePrompt_lesson: What will you remember or do differently?
ePrompt_next: Choose one realistic action. You can turn it into a Task after saving.
ePrompt_hypothesis: What do you expect to happen, and why?
ePrompt_method: What will you do, when and how will you compare it?
ePrompt_observations: Record what you actually noticed, including unexpected details.
ePrompt_evidence: Describe supporting facts. Attach files from the saved entry if useful.
ePrompt_result: What happened in practice? Leave blank until you have a result.
ePrompt_conclusions: What does the result suggest? What remains uncertain?
eTemplateHint_daily: Recall one moment, name your feelings and choose a useful next step.
eTemplateHint_weekly: Look back at the week: what worked, what was difficult and what to change next week.
eTemplateHint_gratitude: Name a specific thing you appreciate and how you could show that appreciation.
eTemplateHint_decision: Record the choice, expected outcome and evidence. Return later to compare the actual result.
eTemplateHint_experiment: Change one small thing. Define your expectation and method before recording observations and conclusions.
eTemplateHint_skill: Choose a skill, plan one practice session and record what improved or needs another attempt.
eTemplateHint_mistake: Describe what happened without judging yourself. Identify a lesson and a small preventive action.
eTemplateHint_success: Record what went well, the evidence and the habits or choices worth repeating.
eTemplateHint_conversation: Recall the discussion, your feelings and what you understood about the other person.
eTemplateHint_reading: Summarize a useful idea, your interpretation and one way to apply it. Link the source book after saving.
eTemplateHint_wellbeing: Observe a small daily change and your own response. Record facts rather than assuming a cause.
eTemplateHint_project: Review the goal, actual outcomes, helpful practices and changes for the next project.
egTitle: Give your entry a short, clear title. Then choose Next.
haPurpose: Choose when to practice and what counts as a completed day. Changes start today; saved daily targets and past check-ins stay intact.
haQuotaHint: Weeks start Monday; months use the calendar. Pauses and partial first/final periods reduce the requirement to the available days. Extra activity is still recorded.
haCategoryHint: Use the same category name to group related habits.
haGoalHint: This goal includes your saved history. It counts real completed days, including extra activity; nothing is filled in automatically.
haInvalid: Check amounts, dates and goal. Enter whole positive numbers and keep the end date after the start.
haGuideType: Choose a real schedule. Weekday plans name fixed days; quotas let you complete any available days in the period.
haGuideQuantity: Set the amount that makes one day complete. Earlier recorded targets stay attached to their days.
haGuideGoal: Optionally choose a goal for your total completed days and a target date. You can leave this blank.
haGuideSave: Save the real settings. Help finishes only after the update succeeds.
haGoalOverdue: Target date has passed; your progress is preserved.
haCalendarHint: Colored dates are completed days. Select a date to review its saved entry. You can edit today or an earlier day; future dates never earn progress.
haGuideCalendar: Choose today or a past date on the real calendar. Only an explicit Save changes history.
haGuideAmount: Enter the actual amount for that day, including zero. Do not fill in activity that did not happen. Then choose Next.
haGuideCheckSave: Save the real check-in. Its recorded target is preserved and statistics update only after successful persistence.
haGuideResult: Your saved day now appears in the calendar and totals. Unrecorded and future days are never presented as completed.
moduleReminderMessage: A reminder is ready. Open Bilga to review it.
moduleReminderQuiet: Quiet notification at your chosen local time. Personal text is kept private.
moduleReminderLimits: Reminders follow your schedule, pauses and completed periods. Android permissions, battery saving and force-stopping the app can delay or stop delivery. Open Bilga after a restore to renew its local reminder cache.
moduleReminderSyncError: Your settings are saved, but Android reminders could not be updated. Retry to sync them.
moduleReminderUnavailable: Android reminders are not ready. Retry when the app is available.
moduleReminderApproximate: Exact alarms are not allowed; Android may deliver this reminder later.
moduleReminderBattery: Android reports background restrictions for this app.
fpPurpose: Plan spending, track savings and remember real debt deadlines. Plans change your balance only when you confirm an actual transaction.
fpGuideAdd: Add a category for your own spending. Nothing is created by this guide.
fpGuideName: Enter a useful name. The parent you selected groups this category in budgets. Then select Next.
fpGuideSave: Save your category. The guide continues only after it is actually stored.
fpGuideResults: Review saved plans here. Budgets use actual expenses, savings goals use the selected account balance, and recurring plans await your confirmation.
fpSkipExplain: Skip this planned occurrence without recording a transaction or changing your balance.
fpPostExplain: Only confirm after this payment or income actually happened. Confirmation records the displayed amount and date once. Plans never post automatically.
fpPlannedOnly: Remaining plans for this month (not a balance forecast)
fpNoInventedBalances: These are intentions, not recorded money. No exchange rates or future balances are estimated.
fpStale: This ledger changed elsewhere. Refresh before saving again. Your saved transactions remain intact.
fpCategoryNamesFixed: Category names match transaction categories exactly. Select the tree button to change grouping while keeping past records intact.
fpBudgetScope: A category budget includes its subcategories. Parent and child budgets overlap; do not add them together. Warnings use recorded expenses through today.
fpGoalBalanceInfo: Progress is the actual balance of the chosen account through today. It does not reserve or transfer money. Goals sharing one account show the same available balance.
fpDebtInfo: Only outstanding recorded debts appear here. A deadline or reminder does not create a repayment. Record actual repayments from transaction details.
fpReminderOneTime: An optional quiet reminder fires once at the chosen local time on the deadline date. Past times are not replayed; repaid or voided debts stop reminders after refresh.
fpGuideAddbudget: Add a monthly budget. Choose all expenses or one category, including its children.
fpGuideNamebudget: Enter your own spending limit. Check the month, then select Next. No example amount is saved.
fpGuideAddgoal: Add a savings goal and choose the real account whose balance you want to track.
fpGuideNamegoal: Name your goal, such as an emergency fund. Select Next when it describes your own intention.
fpGuideAddrecurring: Create a recurring plan. Choose an account, income or expense, frequency and category. It will await confirmation.
fpGuideNamerecurring: Give this plan a name. It describes an expected payment, without recording a transaction.
fpGuideAdddebt: Choose the deadline control for this real outstanding debt. A deadline does not repay it.
fpGuideNamedebt: Review or choose the actual agreed date, then select Next. You may enable a quiet reminder after saving.
fpGuideAmount: Enter your own amount in this journal’s currency. No exchange rate is assumed. Then select Next.
fpGuideSavePlan: Save this plan. The next step appears only after a successful write. You can exit the tutorial without saving.
fpGuideAddcategory: Add a category for your own spending. Nothing is created by this guide.
fpGuideNamecategory: Enter a useful name. The parent you selected groups this category in budgets. Then select Next.
fpGuideJournalCreate: Create a journal for one currency. This adds no transactions or assumed balance.
fpGuideJournalName: Name your journal, then select Next. Use a name you will recognize.
fpGuideJournalCurrency: Check the currency. All accounts and amounts in this journal use it. Separate currencies use separate journals.
fpGuideJournalSave: Save your journal. The guide advances only when it is actually saved.
fpGuideJournalResults: Your journal is ready. Add real accounts and transactions, open reports, or use Financial plans for budgets, goals and deadlines.
helpNoResults: No matching help. Try another word or a module name.
helpIntro: Choose what you want to do. Each guide uses real controls and waits for successful actions. You choose your own content.
helpPrivacy: Help works offline. Opening a guide creates no personal records. Back, Next, Skip and Exit control the guide; they do not undo your saved work.
helpnotesPurpose: Keep ideas, meeting notes and useful information together so you can find them later.
helpnotesExamples: Templates include practical writing structures. Open Templates from Add, preview a suitable example, then explicitly apply it. A blank note works too.
helpnotesStart: Tap Add → New note. Give it a title and write your own text. Bilga autosaves your edits; Save confirms the write and returns to the list.
helpnotesResults: Find the saved note in the list or shared search. Open its History to inspect earlier content. Folders, tags, favorites and archive help organize your material.
helptasksPurpose: Turn an intention into a clear next action. Keep deadlines, priorities and checklists with the task, then mark actual completion.
helptasksExamples: Use the task template gallery for a reusable checklist or make a project with lists and tasks. Preview before applying; examples do not complete any work for you.
helptasksStart: Tap Add → New task. Write one actionable title, optionally add details, a date and a reminder, then Save. Reminders are optional.
helptasksResults: The task stays visible until you mark it done. Today shows upcoming and overdue work; project summaries and filters show actual completion. Repeating tasks create the next occurrence after completion.
helphabitsPurpose: A habit is a small action you repeat to build a useful routine. Start with something manageable and track what actually happened.
helphabitsExamples: Choose from 22 built-in templates, such as reading, walking or planning. Preview and customize the days and quantity before saving. No completion is added by a template.
helphabitsStart: Create a habit, choose its days and a small target. Track today’s amount. Advanced settings offer intervals, weekly or monthly quotas, pauses, goals and an optional reminder time.
helphabitsResults: Open Statistics from the habit menu for a calendar, weekly chart and daily/weekly/monthly totals. Select an actual past day to correct it. Streaks use scheduled days or completed quota periods.
helpfinancePurpose: Understand real income, spending, accounts and outstanding debts. Keep each currency in its own journal.
helpfinanceExamples: Financial plans offers a preview of everyday categories and blank budget, savings-goal and recurring-plan forms. It never supplies invented amounts or transactions.
helpfinanceStart: Create a journal and choose its currency. Add only real account balances and transactions. Open Financial plans to set a monthly budget, track an account-based savings goal or record a debt deadline.
helpfinanceResults: Reports show recorded income, expenses and cash flow. Budget warnings use actual spending. Goal progress uses the chosen account balance. Confirm a recurring transaction only when it actually happened.
helpexperiencesPurpose: Learn from a day, a new skill or a small experiment. Record what happened, what you learned and what to try next.
helpexperiencesExamples: Preview 12 practical templates for reflection, learning or experiments. Experiment fields explain the question, method, observations, evidence, result and conclusion in ordinary language.
helpexperiencesStart: Choose New experience or a template. Write your own title and reflection, check the date, then Save. Use experiment mode when you want a structured test.
helpexperiencesResults: Review entries in the timeline or calendar. History preserves previous content; restoring creates a new version. Add evidence files or existing links, and turn a useful follow-up into a Task.
helpbooksPurpose: Read your own books offline and remember what you learn. Continue at the saved location and keep reading notes with the book.
helpbooksExamples: Use a reading-note or knowledge-card template to capture a useful idea in your own words. Import your own PDF, EPUB or TXT; no book is downloaded or bought automatically.
helpbooksStart: Choose Add book, select your document and decide whether to keep an encrypted copy or a file reference. Open the book and start reading; publication details are optional.
helpbooksResults: Continue reading shows your saved position. Bookmarks, notes, knowledge-card reviews and reading statistics help you revisit actual work. Deleting an external original makes its reference unavailable until you relink it.
helpGuideCreate: Use Add to open the real editor. This guide will not create an example for you.
helpGuideTitle: Write a title you will recognize later, then select Next.
helpGuideNoteBody: Write your own idea here, then select Next. Notes keep their existing autosave behavior.
helpGuideTaskBody: Add useful details if you need them. A task can be saved with just its title. Select Next to continue.
helpGuideNoteSave: Use Save to confirm that your edits are stored and return to the list. A failed write keeps the editor open.
helpGuideTaskSave: Save your real task. The guide continues only after the database write succeeds.
helpGuideResults: Your saved item is in this real list. Search or open it to review your work. Back cannot repeat the saved action.
voiceShortcut: Tap to speak, review the text, then choose the action
voicePurpose: Use your voice or type a command. Bilga shows the words first and opens real controls. Nothing runs just because it was recognized.
voiceDeviceLimit: Device recognition depends on installed language support. Uzbek/offline accuracy has not been certified. If the language is unavailable, type or explicitly choose the system recognizer.
voiceSystemPrivacy: The Android speech service may send your speech to its provider over the network. Bilga does not save audio or call paid AI APIs. Continue only if you want to use this service.
voiceConversationHint: Ask questions about your plan, habits, recent writing or weekly spending. Bilga listens again after each answer. Silence or leaving this screen ends the session. Other commands need your review.
voiceListening: Listening now. Cancel or leave this screen to stop.
voiceUnknown: This command is unclear or unsupported. Edit the text or use one of the examples. No action was taken.
voiceConfirmFlow: Continue opens the actual draft, search or selection. Review its details before saving. Financial and habit changes require an explicit confirmation.
voiceExamplesText:
Create note: a useful idea
Search notes: project
Create task: read a chapter
Remind me tomorrow at 09:00 to read
Complete habit: Walking
Record expense: 12.50 USD lunch
Record income: 100 USD
Search finance: transport
Create experience: what I learned today
Open book: title
Continue reading
Create knowledge card: an important idea
Search my data: project
voicePermission: Microphone permission was not granted. You can type a command or enable it in app permissions.
voiceLanguageUnavailable: The selected recognizer cannot use this language now. Try another available language/service or type the command.
voiceNetwork: The system speech service could not connect. Your previous text is kept; you can type or retry.
voiceNoSpeech: No clear speech was recognized. Try again or type the command.
voiceUnavailable: A usable speech service is unavailable. Typed commands remain available.
voiceNoMatch: No matching saved item. Correct the name or search in its module. Nothing was created.
voiceHabitAlreadyDone: This habit is already complete today. No duplicate check-in was added.
voiceNeedLedger: Create a journal in the spoken currency first. No amount was converted and no transaction was added.
orgDeleteInfo: Move this folder to Trash? Its records remain accessible and the folder can be restored.
fxArchiveCategoryInfo: This category is in use. Archive it to hide it from new transactions and keep its existing links.
vaNoVoice: The Android speech engine has no installed voice for this language. The answer is available above.
vaUnavailable: Audio playback is unavailable. You can read the answer above.
vaMoreInModule: Open Notes or Experiences for more saved entries.
